info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Carbon Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Carbon Battery Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information about carbon battery products. This API enables businesses to populate their catalog with specifications, features, and other relevant data, ensuring that customers have access to accurate product information. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and product cataloging services. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their product offerings and enhance customer experience through well-documented carbon battery details.

post.description: This operation allows you to submit details for a new carbon battery. Provide all necessary information in the request body to successfully create and record the battery details in the system.

requestBody.description: Submit details for a carbon battery operation. This request body requires specific information about the battery's parameters and specifications in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

quantity.description: The quantity of carbon batteries requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the carbon battery.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier of the carbon battery.
